title: US bond market closed all day for Veterans Day — with NYSE equities trading a full session, the only full-day cross-asset schedule split in November 2027
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule', SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) and parsed out of the page's embedded RSC payload by this session. The US 2027 panel renders holiday/date/note triples in sequence and this one reads exactly 'Veterans Day' / 'Thursday, November 11, 2027' with an EMPTY note field — the full-closure shape, distinct from the early-close entries in the same panel (e.g. 'Thanksgiving Day' / 'Thursday, November 25, 2027' / 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 26, 2027'). Panel attribution verified by the surrounding US-only run (U.S. Independence Day / Labor Day / Columbus Day / Veterans Day / Thanksgiving / Christmas) and cross-validated against the Memorial Day 2027 card that this repo's sifma-bond-early-close-2027-05-28 entry already quotes verbatim. INDEPENDENTLY CORROBORATED FROM A SECOND, NON-SIFMA PRIMARY fetched the same session: the OCC's 2027 expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) marks 2027-11-11 'Bank holiday' — its bond-only flag, distinct from the 'Exchange/OCC holiday' hatched marker it puts on 2027-11-25 — and marks no other November 2027 date either way. EQUITY SIDE CHECKED, NOT ASSUMED: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes, parsed cell-by-cell the same session) lists ten holidays per year for 2026/2027/2028 — New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Washington's Birthday, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day — and the strings 'Veterans' and 'Columbus' do not appear anywhere on the page, so NYSE equities trade a full 09:30-16:00 ET session on 2027-11-11 while the recommended fixed-income tape is dark. Filed estimate on the same three counts as every sibling SIFMA entry: no confirmed prefix exists for a trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an in-sweep discovery, and SIFMA's schedule is a recommendation rather than a market-wide halt. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the thanksgiving-market-closure-2027-11-25 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08). HONEST SCOPE NOTE, STATED FIRST: 2027-11-11 is D-14 from the proposing event and therefore OUTSIDE its +/-5-day corridor. It is proposed anyway on two grounds — it was read first-hand off the same SIFMA panel fetch the proposing event's own bond leg rests on, and it is a documented hole in an id class this calendar already carries: sifma-bond-market-closure-2026-11-11 is the identical event one year earlier, filed by the boj-summary-of-opinions-2026-11-10 sweep on 2026-09-05, and it has no 2027 successor. A reader who wants the corridor-only reading should ignore this file; nothing in the proposing event's stance depends on it. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE NOVEMBER 2027 STRUCTURE the proposing ledger maps: November 2027 carries 21 NYSE equity sessions (22 weekdays minus Thanksgiving; the maximum in the 1970-2025 range of 18-21, mean 20.38) but only 20 recommended bond sessions, because 11-11 removes one from the fixed-income side alone. Any month-long cross-asset normalisation over November 2027 is therefore dividing two different denominators, and the sibling entry records the same trap for 2026. ID-CLASS INCONSISTENCY RECORDED RATHER THAN RESOLVED: this calendar names the identical shape two ways — sifma-bond-market-closure-2026-10-12 and -2026-11-11 for 2026, but sifma-bond-holiday-close-2027-10-11 for Columbus Day 2027. This file follows the same holiday's own prior-year id (sifma-bond-market-closure-2026-11-11) rather than the adjacent-year one, because matching the event is the stronger tie; which convention should win is not this lane's call and is left for whoever takes the entry. HONEST LIMITS. (1) EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no market-structure member, so this is filed 'rates', the choice every sibling SIFMA entry already made. (2) CME futures hours on 2027-11-11 are NOT asserted — cmegroup.com has 403'd this runner in every sibling lane and was not re-attempted. (3) Whether Treasury moves any 11-11 auction or settlement off the closed day is likewise not asserted; treasurydirect.gov was not fetched. IMPACT low, symbols [] — a recommended closure moves nothing by itself. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
